_comment: POST /api/run request and response. The learner's TypeScript is executed on the server against a real Chromium. The live browser view does NOT travel in this response - it streams separately over the WebSocket at /api/run/:run_id/stream as screencast frames. This response is the terminal result.

problem_number._comment: Set when the run is an attempt at a practice problem, so it can be recorded against progress. null otherwise.

code._comment: TypeScript as typed in the editor. The runner rewrites the course's deno-helpers import and injects launch/show/login/USERS/BASE_URL as ambient bindings.

run_id._comment: Also the WebSocket stream key. Available before execution starts so the client can attach first.

error._comment: Populated when status is error: the thrown message and stack, with the runner's own frames stripped so the learner sees their own line numbers.

screenshot._comment: base64 PNG from the course's show() helper, or the final frame when screencast was unavailable. null when the code never opened a page.

blocked_url._comment: Set when status is blocked: the navigation the allowlist refused.
